title: TBD Terrain Manifest
description: Per-terrain map asset manifest (DEM + optional tile pyramid). Values for pixel dimensions and height range must come from World Editor Info & Diags at export — do not guess.

terrainId.description: Terrain key — must match an entry in terrain-registry.json (same id namespace as assets_v2/terrains/{terrainId}/).

worldBounds.description: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] meters — must match coords/terrains.ts

metersPerPixel.description: Planar resolution from Info & Diags (Everon Biki: 2 m).

widthPx.description: DEM width in pixels. 0 marks a stub manifest whose DEM export has not run.

heightPx.description: DEM height in pixels. 0 marks a stub manifest whose DEM export has not run.

raw.description: The TBDE raw-u16 twin of the DEM PNG, streamed into one `Vec<u16>` instead of decoded through a PNG codec. Optional: absent means the PNG above is the only elevation source. Mirrors `DemRawBlock` in the map engine's world manifest module.

tiles.description: Dual basemap pyramids. A bare `urlTemplate` is an alias for the satellite pyramid. `satellite` and `map` are the two switchable views; both share bounds and zoom range and both use the XYZ disk layout with fetch-time Y inversion.

encoding.description: Tile codec. webp-lossless (VP8L) is the picture-perfect satellite pyramid; webp-lossy (VP8 at quality N) is for interim and development builds.

delivery.description: Primary satellite delivery. `unified` is one tbd-sat bundle fetched as a single GPU texture with mips; `pyramid` is per-viewport {z}/{x}/{y} tiles. The frontend falls back to the pyramid when the unified bundle is missing or unreadable.

waterComposite.description: True when the satellite ortho has engine-sourced hydrology composited onto it: ocean where the DEM is at or below sea level, inland water from the supertexture water appearance filtered by the DEM. Provenance is the staging export's own `waterComposite` metadata block.

unified.description: Unified satellite bundle (tbd-sat v1): a GLB-style container of lossless-WebP mip blocks, fetched once and uploaded as a single mipmapped GPU texture.

encoding.description: Which tbd-sat layout to expect. tbd-sat-v1 is the hand-packed tile table; tbd-sat-v2 replaces that index with an rkyv `TbdSatIndexV2` behind the same magic. The reader dispatches on the file's own version field, so this string only tells a loader which one to expect.

source.description: N9 — synthesized-cartographic = DEM hillshade + land-cover LUT + baked road vectors when Workbench has no cartographic export; UI labels it "Synthetic map".

encoding.description: Tile codec. webp-lossy (VP8 at quality N) is the Map-view default, because that view is a stylized cartographic raster; lossless is a satellite-only requirement.

objects.description: Catalog v1 world-object pointers and counts. Optional until a terrain has had its first object export.

transforms.description: What a chunk row can carry beyond its position, at objects schemaVersion 1.1.0. `yaw` means 5-wide v1 tuples only; `yaw+pitch+roll` means 8-wide rows exist but the export carried no scale, so every scale is 1; `yaw+pitch+roll+scale` means the full-export plugin wrote `GetScale()`.

scaleSource.description: Where the per-row scale comes from: `absent` (the export predates scale capture, so unit scale is assumed everywhere) or `GetScale` (the full-export plugin read it from the entity).

workbenchVersion.description: The Workbench build that produced the world export, copied from the export metadata when the plugin wrote one; omitted otherwise.

typeInventoryPath.description: Relative path to `type-inventory.json`, which carries the exact prefab and instance counts for this terrain.

densityPath.description: Reserved: relative directory of the per-chunk tree and rock corner-density grids, `objects/density/{cx}_{cy}.bin` in the TBDD binary format. Declared here; no export writes it.

densityCellM.description: Reserved: density grid cell size in metres, locked at 32 — 17x17 corners per 512 m chunk.

lod.description: Reserved: snapshot of the LOD gate constants for cache-busting — `refZoom` plus the per-class `minZoom` gates. Declared here; no export writes it.

binary.description: The TBDC chunk container plus the four Tier-2 rkyv archives that replace the `objects/*.json.gz` set. Optional: absent means the JSON paths above are the only ones. Mirrors `ObjectsBinaryBlock` in the map engine's world manifest module. `container`, `containerVersion`, `pod` and `podBytes` are on the wire so that a loader can refuse a row shape it does not implement (`ObjectsBinaryBlock::matches_this_build`) rather than read a 24-byte-row file at a 32-byte stride and draw a map made of garbage that never errors.

containerVersion.description: CONTAINER_VERSION. Pinned, not open: a v2 manifest must fail this schema until the reader that understands v2 lands.

pod.description: POD_NAME — the 32-byte row documented in map-object-instance.schema.json $defs/objectInstancePodRow.

podBytes.description: POD_BYTES. Every offset in the format is 32 + 32 * index.

chunks.description: Path template carrying BOTH {cx} and {cy}, e.g. objects/chunks/{cx}_{cy}.bin. A template missing either placeholder resolves every chunk in the world to one URL (chunk_bin_path returns None and the loader stays on JSON).

typeInventory.description: objects/type-inventory.rkyv; the inventory also lives inside the prefab catalogue.

labels.description: The rkyv label archive that replaces `locations.json` and the road-name JSON. Optional. Mirrors `LabelsBlock` in the map engine's world manifest module.

water.description: Water vectors as an rkyv archive, plus the TBDB mipmapped bathymetry raster. Optional. Mirrors `WaterBlock` in the map engine's world manifest module.

bathymetry.description: e.g. water/bathymetry.tbd-bath. Absent on a terrain with no bathymetry bake.

buildings.description: One `BuildingBlueprintArchive` fetch in place of 1623 individual descriptor fetches, plus the directory its `.bvh` sidecars are indexed out of. Optional. Mirrors `BuildingsBlock` in the map engine's world manifest module.

blas.description: Directory of the .bvh sidecars, e.g. prefabs/blas.

glyphs.description: World-object SVG and atlas pointers. Optional.

locations.description: Named settlements and peaks used for cartographic labels.
